name: VoiceStudio
description: VoiceStudio is the open-source, fully-local ElevenLabs alternative — voice cloning, voice design, video dubbing, dictation, transcription & audiobook creation in 646 languages.
one_liner: A free, offline app that clones voices, narrates text, dubs videos into other languages, and transcribes speech — the same things ElevenLabs charges a subscription for, but running entirely on your own computer.
buyer: A self-published author on Amazon KDP who wants an audiobook version of their book without paying a $200+/hour narration studio.
business_use_cases: A self-publishing author produces and sells the audiobook edition of their own novel without hiring a narrator.
A YouTube channel dubs its videos into Spanish, Hindi, and Portuguese to reach new audiences without hiring voice actors per language.
A medical or legal practice uses the local dictation and transcription features to convert dictated notes into text without sending audio to a cloud vendor.

money_ideas.idea: Run a for-hire audiobook production service for indie authors, priced per finished hour of audio.
Offer a video-dubbing subscription service for YouTube channels expanding into new language markets.
Sell dictation/transcription setup as a one-time service to clinics that need on-prem privacy.

steal_this: Launch a $150-per-audiobook narration side hustle for self-published authors this weekend — undercut professional studios by 80% using free voice cloning.
